data.name: Battle Force 2249
data.detailed_description:
BATTLE FORCE 2249 is a character RPG set in a living galaxy — a place that feels inhabited,

where the story finds you because you were desperate enough to be in the wrong place at the wrong

time. This is a game about who you become, not just what you fight.

STORY

The galaxy is fracturing. For generations the Axiom Collective has controlled the story everyone believes — and buried the truth about the Meridian beneath it. You are the Disgraced: last of a bloodline of star-cartographers who alone mapped the Meridian's path. The Collective needed that knowledge, then needed it gone. They jettisoned you into a debris field and left you to die.

They were wrong. With no allegiance and almost nothing left, you start pulling a thread that could unmake everything they've built.

A LIVING WORLD — ALONE, BUT NOT QUITE ALONE

Other pilots move through the galaxy around you, living their own lives. The world is inhabited, not empty — somewhere to belong to, learn from, and be surprised by. Sometimes the ship on your scope isn't an enemy at all.

YOUR SHIP, YOUR IDENTITY

Your ship begins as an anonymous Collective registration number. You name it. You build it — slot earned weapons, modules and gear, chase complete sets for their bonuses, and tune a loadout that's unmistakably yours. The ship is the character.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Pull threads, not chores — character-driven stories and a central mystery that rewards curiosity, with side leads and hidden intrigue to follow.

  • Make the ship yours — deep load out and customisation; collect gear sets for powerful bonuses.

  • Earn and craft weapons and upgrades that change how you play; hunt rare loot worth the trip.

  • Choose your factions in a war where no side is clean — and live with the consequences.

  • Explore a galaxy with history and face challenges — and the occasional boss — that test the ship you built.

  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics Card 1GB, NVidia 750 or higher

  • Processor: Intel i5
